description: Search Skamper's curated UK running-route database when the user gives concrete filters — name, location (lat/lng), distance range, max ascent, paved surface %, course shape, or national park. Returns up to 20 compact route summaries with canonical URLs. If the user instead describes who they are or what they want ('I'm a trail runner who hates roads'), prefer recommend_route. For parkrun-distance asks, prefer find_5k.

max_ascent_m.description: Maximum total ascent in metres (flatter routes).

national_park.description: Filter to routes in this national park (name or slug).

near_lat.description: Latitude to search near. Pair with near_lng.

near_lng.description: Longitude to search near. Pair with near_lat.

query.description: Free text — searches route titles and slugs. Optional.

name: search_routes
title: Search routes
